ref.quote: Rate limit: set by GOOGLE_OAUTH_RATE_LIMIT, in requests per minute per IP across /auth/google/redirect and /callback, default 10. One Google login is 2 requests, so the default allows about 5 logins per minute per IP. It has its own bucket, so register and password-reset attempts don't use it up. Staging can use a different value from prod; if testers behind one office IP hit 429s, tell me and I'll raise it there. The 2FA step has its own limit (Fortify's two-factor limiter, 10/min per challenge and IP), same as after a password.
